integrity: An unrestricted finite combinatorial proof with a transparent exhaustive Python 3 checker is supplied; no external or independent mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the fourteen-vertex Heawood graph and four total-dominating sets with exactly two memberships at each vertex; not an all-cubic enumeration and not an automorphism-quotient count. Some plausible primary full texts were only partially accessible. Publication priority remains subject to unindexed literature.
title: Exact four-fold total-domination witnesses of the Heawood graph
